# tinyfmt

Small helpers for formatting numbers in fixed-width text output.

## Install

    npm install tinyfmt

## Usage

```js
const { pad, format } = require("tinyfmt");

pad(42, 6);        // "    42"
format(1234567);   // "1,234,567"
```

### pad(value, width)

Right-aligns `value` in a field `width` characters wide. The value is converted
with `parseFloat` first, so numeric strings are accepted.

### format(value)

Adds thousands separators using the `en-US` locale.
